title.zh: Trump concession sends CLARITY Act odds above 32% before make-or-break Senate vote
title.en: Trump concession sends CLARITY Act odds above 32% before make-or-break Senate vote

current_state.zh: Senate Republicans released a 635-page final CLARITY Act compromise incorporating 126 Democratic-requested changes and stricter ethics rules, lifting Polymarket odds of the crypto market-structure bill becoming law above 32% ahead of Tuesday's 60-vote cloture test.
